semantic_checks: Provisional Bernoulli visibility and Gaussian-mixture draw precede clipping; final visibility and total are reset together.
Centered log layer and channel targets use a 1e-8 fraction floor, a 1e-12 GeV denominator floor, and zero inactive coordinates.
Masked flow-matching MSE divides by the number of active coordinates across the batch; both generation flows use eight current-state updates at midpoint times.
Graph aggregation sums directed-edge messages without degree normalization, then layer means enter a two-layer bidirectional transformer.
Gumbel perturbed top-k uses score divided by fixed temperature and clipped uniforms; it fixes counts but not graph connectivity.
The nine-term joint loss includes the transformed-response Jacobian, sampled positive-negative ranking, and downweighted inactive zero counts.
The decoder closes sampled layer budgets, not incident neutron energy.
